description: Modoc - Heather Hadwick, candidate for CA State Assembly District 1, is proud to announce the endorsement of Karin Rosser, a respected community leader and Flying U Rodeo Company owner. Karin, alongside her late husband Cotton Rosser, has made remarkable contributions to the world of rodeo production. Cotton purchased the Flying U Rodeo Company after a ranch accident in 1956. For several decades, the Rosser family has run Flying U, the oldest continuing rodeo stock company in the United States.H
